title: A Pup Gets a Bun
lines: Bev, Dan and Sal are on a rug.
Bev and Dan have buns and jam.
Sal has a tan pup. It naps.
Bev sets a bun on the rug.
It gets the bun. It runs to Sal.
"The pup has the bun!" said Bev.
Dan lets Bev have a bit of his bun.
Bev dips the bit in the jam.
The pup naps on the rug.
